text: You're about to hire a fucking setter, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Thirty DMs a day, bro. Human versus AI, winner gets my inbox.
style: Hyped and cocky, a casual American guy announcing a fight to his buddy, a little beat after bro.

text: You rented a fucking boxing ring to hire a setter.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last word.
Cocky and playful, like a ring announcer, short and punchy.

text: PayScale says thirteen to twenty-one an hour, plus commission. Full time, over two grand a month.
style: Calm and matter-of-fact, reading the numbers clearly, a small beat between the two sentences.
Skeptical, a quick challenge, eyebrow raised.

text: A hundred nineteen a month. Fifteen hundred replies included.
style: Smooth and smug, a small proud beat after month.
Hyped and loud, a happy shout, like he just won the fight.

text: Easy, champ. Thirty new chats a day needs extra replies, thirty-nine per five hundred.
style: Calm and honest, slowing him down, a little amused, clear on the numbers.
Stubborn and a bit annoyed, crossing his arms, a beat after two.

text: Any hour, in your voice. He sleeps, like a normal person.
style: Sly and dry, a small beat before the second sentence, warm on the last words.
Convinced and a bit surprised, short.

text: Nope. He's better on the sales call, big deals, new objections.
style: Suddenly dead serious and honest, a hard beat after Nope, then steady and respectful.
Confused, voice going up at the end.

text: Both. Plug me into ManyChat, I qualify and book. He takes the hard cases and the call.
style: Confident and proud, a strong beat after Both, then easy and smooth.

text: Okay. How do I set you up?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: You paid for a fight and got a fucking group hug.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug, savoring group hug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
